mapper.select: select count(*) from emp e where e.status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from attendance a join emp e on e.emp_id = a.emp_id where a.work_date = #{today} and a.check_in_at is not null and e.status = 'ACTIVE'

select e.emp_id, e.ename, d.department_name, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lr.start_date, lr.end_date from leave_request lr join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.status = 'APPROVED' and #{today} between lr.start_date and lr.end_date and e.status = 'ACTIVE'
order by lt.leave_type_id, d.department_id, e.emp_id

select e.emp_id, e.ename, d.department_name, 'LATE' as issue_type, a.check_in_at from attendance a join emp e on e.emp_id = a.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where a.work_date = #{today} and a.status = 'LATE' and e.status = 'ACTIVE'
order by a.check_in_at desc, e.emp_id

select e.emp_id, e.ename, d.department_name, 'ABSENT' as issue_type from emp e join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where e.status = 'ACTIVE' and e.hiredate <= #{today}
and not exists ( select 1 from attendance a where a.emp_id = e.emp_id and a.work_date = #{today} and (a.check_in_at is not null or a.status = 'ON_LEAVE')) and not exists ( select 1 from leave_request lr where lr.emp_id = e.emp_id and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and #{today} between lr.start_date and lr.end_date) order by d.department_id, e.emp_id

select 'LEAVE' as approval_type, lr.leave_request_id as request_id, e.ename, d.department_name, lt.leave_type_name as detail, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.request_date, lr.status from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where lr.approver_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'REQUESTED' union all select 'CORRECTION', ac.attendance_correction_id, e.ename, d.department_name, '출퇴근 시각 정정', ac.work_date, ac.work_date, ac.request_date, ac.status from attendance_correction ac join emp e on e.emp_id = ac.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where ac.approver_id = #{empId} and ac.status = 'REQUESTED' order by request_date

select 'LEAVE' as approval_type, lr.leave_request_id as request_id, e.ename, d.department_name, lt.leave_type_name as detail, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.request_date, lr.status from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'REQUESTED' union all select 'CORRECTION', ac.attendance_correction_id, e.ename, d.department_name, '출퇴근 시각 정정', ac.work_date, ac.work_date, ac.request_date, ac.status from attendance_correction ac join emp e on e.emp_id = ac.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where ac.emp_id = #{empId} and ac.status = 'REQUESTED' order by request_date desc

select 'LEAVE' as approval_type, lr.leave_request_id as request_id, lt.leave_type_name as detail, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.request_date, lr.status from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and lr.end_date >= #{today} order by lr.start_date limit 5
